results.title: Coast Guard searching for plane with 6 aboard that lost contact on a trip from Bermuda to Boston
results.description: An air ambulance vanished over the Atlantic early Saturday with six people aboard while flying from Bermuda to Boston, triggering a search by air and sea in the waters off Nantucket.
